Name: LittleNPCs
Author: candidus42
Description:
Turns your children into little NPCs. Does not provide any assets. Assets must be provided by content packs.

[b]Use a content pack[/b]

Replacement NPCs for your children must be provided by content packs. A popular content pack is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url]. Note that this one consists of two content packs and you need both.

[b]Create a content pack[/b]

For creating a content pack see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:NPC_data]NPC data[/url] in the Stardew Valley Wiki. Note that NPCDispositions must not be provided by your content pack, these are generated and handled internally by the mod.

Starting from version 1.1, the mod provides 2 ContentPatcher tokens:

[list]
[*]Candidus42.LittleNPCs/FirstLittleNPC
[*]Candidus42.LittleNPCs/SecondLittleNPC
[/list]
Every token supports these arguments:

[list]
[*]Name
[*]DisplayName
[*]Gender
[*]BirthSeason
[*]BirthDay
[*]Age
[/list]
The 1.0 tokens are still there but will be removed in the next release.

Only one argument can be given at a time. Token arguments are passed after a colon. For example, if you want the internal name of FirstLittleNPC, use
[i]{{Candidus42.LittleNPCs/FirstLittleNPC: Name}}[/i]

In your content pack, use these tokens instead of hard-coded names and genders.

[b]Convert a ChildToNPC content pack[/b]

Content packs for the unmaintained [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4568]ChildToNPC[/url] mod are supposed to be easily convertible, even though some tokens are not provided.

See [url=https://github.com/mus-candidus/LittleNPCs/blob/main/README.md]README.md[/url] for details.

[b]Notes[/b]

For technical reasons NPC conversion happens at 6:10. You might be able to see your unconverted children before. This is expected behavior.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url] for suggestions and bug reports. That really helps to improve this mod :-)

Source code on [url=https://github.com/mus-candidus/LittleNPCs]GitHub[/url]
